in_marathi.name: Deeparyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Deepa (lamp) + Arya (noble) + Ansh (sign)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deeparyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Deeparyansh is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a combination of the words 'Deepa' and 'Arya' meaning 'lamp' and 'noble' respectively, and 'Ansh' meaning 'sign'. This name is believed to represent a noble sign of enlightenment, like a lamp guiding the path to wisdom and knowledge.
